what: better-sqlite3 fails at runtime in Bun-compiled binaries. Symptom: `Could not find module root given file: "/$bunfs/root/<binary>". Do you have a package.json file?` thrown from `bindings` package's `getRoot()`. Root cause: the `bindings` npm package (used by better-sqlite3 to locate its .node binding) walks the physical filesystem up to find a package.json — Bun's /$bunfs/ virtual FS has none. Bun compile bundles the code fine; it's the runtime dlopen lookup that fails. Confirmed workaround: `bun:sqlite` (built-in, no N-API bindings) compiles + runs cleanly. 90%+ API-compatible for the aide-memory operations (prepare/all/get/run/iterate, pragma, close, transactions). Sidecar .node patching is fragile and not recommended.
why: Phase 1 spike confirmed this. Any future spawn trying to compile aide-memory with Bun will hit this exact error. Pre-recording the root cause + confirmed fallback saves hours of diagnosis.
